Rama Navami.title: Rama Navami: Ramayana Film and Indian Dinner
Rama Navami.intro: Celebrate the birth of Lord Rama on April 15, 2027 (MSS Ujjain Hindu calendar convention).

schedule.detail: Read about Rama, Sita and the Ramayana, and discuss dharma, courage and compassion.
Family screening of Nitesh Tiwari's 2026 film Ramayana, starring Ranbir Kapoor as Rama. Confirm home viewing availability closer to the holiday.
Enjoy an Indian meal together; consider dal, vegetable biryani, naan, raita and sweets.

Rama Navami.closing: Share gratitude and reflect on Rama's example.

Holika Dahan.title: Holika Dahan: Bonfire and the Story of Prahlada
Holika Dahan.intro: An evening of storytelling, reflection, and hospitality around the Hindu spring bonfire observance. Consult your local temple for the observance date and muhurat.

schedule.detail: Prepare gujiya, roasted chickpeas, and non-infused thandai to share. Arrange to attend a local community bonfire or prepare an outdoor fire where permitted.

schedule.activity: Tell the story of Prahlada and Holika
schedule.detail: Tell how Prahlada remains devoted to Vishnu despite his father Hiranyakashipu’s demands, and survives the fire in which Holika perishes. Discuss courage, devotion, and the triumph of good over evil.
Join a community observance for the bonfire, prayers, and songs. At home, gather for storytelling and reflection; religious ceremonies and fire-lighting times follow local practice.
Enjoy sweets and drinks together, and look ahead to celebrating colors at Holi.

Holika Dahan.closing: The calendar currently lists published India civil dates for 2026–2027 only. Local temple dates and auspicious times may differ; future dates await verification.
